title: Upright Abdominal X-Ray Demonstrating Small Bowel Obstruction
author: James Heilman, MD
caption: Upright abdominal radiograph demonstrating multiple dilated small bowel loops with classic step-ladder air-fluid levels.
alt_text: Upright abdominal X-ray showing gas-distended small bowel loops and air-fluid levels.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates classic radiographic findings of small bowel obstruction (CLIFF-037, p.5-7).
